about: Profile files (GUI profiles, format version 1) and what checkProfileFile (viewer.js) and check_profile_file (stoms.viewer.profiles) make of them: the profile and warnings, or the error message. Both run every case (tests/test_viewer_profile_file.py) against this registry.

cases.title: empty controls (every control by its level)
unknown IDs ignored, also names of object properties
warnings: Unknown control "future.thing" ignored (from a newer STOMS, or a typo).
Unknown control "constructor" ignored (from a newer STOMS, or a typo).
Unknown control "__proto__" ignored (from a newer STOMS, or a typo).
Unknown control "toString" ignored (from a newer STOMS, or a typo).

cases.title: an old ID counts as its new one
the new ID wins over its old one (old first)
the new ID wins over its old one (new first)
a control no profile hides: false ignored, true kept
warnings: Control "embed.never" cannot be hidden by a profile; false ignored.
